dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. I love camping.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈɪz. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈkæmpɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, with my family. But this tent is bigger than our tent at home.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli. bʌt ðɪs ˈtɛnt ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðən aʊər ˈtɛnt ət ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the sleeping bags are warm, aren't they?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈsliːpɪŋ ˌbæɡz ər ˈwɔːrm, ˈɑːrnt ðeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, they are. It gets cold here at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðeɪ ˈɑːr. ɪt ˈɡɛts ˈkoʊld ˈhɪr ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We aren't going to see any wild animals, are we?
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈɑːrnt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsiː ˈɛni ˈwaɪld ˈænɪməlz, ər wiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We might! Wild elephants sometimes walk near the camp.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈmaɪt! ˈwaɪld ˈɛləfənts ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˈwɔːk ˈnɪr ðə ˈkæmp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? Let's get up early tomorrow. We can watch the sunrise, can't we?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈlɛts ˈɡɛt ˈʌp ˈɜːrli təˈmɑːroʊ. wiː kən ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈsʌnraɪz, ˈkænt wiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course! But the sunrise is at six, so don't sleep in!
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs! bʌt ðə ˈsʌnraɪz ɪz ət ˈsɪks, soʊ ˈdoʊnt ˈsliːp ˈɪn!
